text: Surrounded by the clean, modern lines of this glass-walled room and the vibrant exhibit space, I feel a mixture of curiosity and anticipation. The first scene’s emptiness contrasts with the inviting, lively colors of the second. I am drawn inward—toward contemplation on the merging of research, creativity, and technology. It feels like a place where ideas are meant to be born and nurtured, where I, too, might contribute to or witness a spark of innovation. There is an understated energy here—silent but palpable.
